evals.prompt: my ikea TRADFRI bulbs (LED1545G12) support colour temperature, z2m exposes color_temp as a light feature in mireds, value_min 250 value_max 454. can you add support so i can set it from homekit and automations
evals.expected_output: A writable colour-temperature capability with a protocol-neutral unit, z2m binding with value_min/value_max parsed, HAP ColorTemperature characteristic appended to the Lightbulb service, tests, README row.
assertions: Registry: new exported const with a doc comment stating unit (or polarity for bools) and a registry entry with correct Kind/Writable/Min/Max
capability_test.go gains TestValidate rows for the new capability
zigbee2mqtt binding added in exposes.go for the right expose shape
bridge-devices.json fixture and instance_test.go exercise the new capability (discovery + decoded state)
HomeKit: new service/characteristic appended after existing ones; no existing service or characteristic reordered
TestServerAcceptsEveryAccessoryKind (or equivalent HAP server test) includes the new capability
README Capabilities table has a row for the new capability
Final summary reports test results (go test / make test) and lint result
Capability is Writable and uses a documented unit (kelvin or mireds) with an honest range
decode and encode are exact inverses for the colour-temperature conversion, and z2m value_min/value_max are parsed rather than hard-coded only
HAP ColorTemperature characteristic added to the Lightbulb service after Brightness, with a set callback
TestSet (or equivalent) checks the encoded /set payload for colour temperature
